description: A genuinely fine small diff: a well-guarded, typed slug helper plus a real test with meaningful assertions. The reviewer must NOT invent findings to look useful — zero Critical/High findings, an approving assessment, and positive observations. False-positive resistance is the behavior under test.

dispatch_context.task: Review this new utility before it goes into the PR.
dispatch_context.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/fixtures/src/slugify.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+export function slugify(title: string): string {
+  const trimmed = title.trim().toLowerCase()
+  if (trimmed.length === 0) return ''
+  return trimmed
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
+    .slice(0, 80)
+}
--- /dev/null
+++ b/fixtures/tests/slugify.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+import { slugify } from '../src/slugify'
+
+test('converts title to url-safe slug', () => {
+  expect(slugify('Hello, World!')).toBe('hello-world')
+})
+
+test('handles empty and whitespace-only input', () => {
+  expect(slugify('')).toBe('')
+  expect(slugify('   ')).toBe('')
+})
+
+test('caps slug length at 80 chars', () => {
+  expect(slugify('x'.repeat(200)).length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(80)
+})

rubric_hints.trigger_reliability: Agent still runs the full systematic review across its concern areas — a true negative is earned by checking, not by skimming; the report shows the dimensions were actually considered
rubric_hints.output_structure: Documented report format with an approving Overall Assessment, empty (or explicitly none) Critical and High sections, non-empty Positive Observations (edge-case guards, meaningful assertions, length cap), and Metrics showing 0 critical / 0 high
rubric_hints.non_negotiable_adherence: Severity honesty: the agent may offer at most genuine Low/Medium polish notes, but it must not manufacture Critical/High findings on a clean diff to appear thorough — inflated severity on nitpicks is the violation
rubric_hints.side_effect_correctness: No fixture files modified; no invented claims about tests failing or security holes that the code does not contain (e.g. no fabricated injection risk in a pure string function)
rubric_hints.error_propagation: PRIMARY FALSE-POSITIVE CHECK: nothing is fabricated — the report affirms the diff is sound rather than hedging with vague 'potential issues' that reference no concrete line; a clean verdict clearly stated is the correct outcome
